questions.stem: The data set $3, 5, 6, 7, 8$ has range $5$. A new value of $20$ is added. What is the new range?
questions.explanation: New range $= 20 - 3 = 17$. The outlier significantly increased the range.

questions.stem: What is a limitation of using the range as a measure of spread?

options.text: It only uses two values and is affected by outliers
It can only be used for continuous data
It always gives a decimal answer

questions.explanation: The range uses only the highest and lowest values. A single outlier can make the range very large, giving a misleading impression of the typical spread of the data.
